output.description: output from git commands ran as Pkg.Store git sync.

success.description: true, if all Git commands were successful to complete Pkg.Store git sync call.

onErrorSuggestion.description: When git operations were not successful, suggested next course of action to progress.

conflicts.description: true, if the git operation (pull/push/configure) results in any conflicts

pullRequest.description: Link to PR (pull request), if it is created due to conflicts on pull/push operation

branch.description: Branch name where changes are published, (if conflicts are found) to generate PR.
